items.title: Sabalenka into Brisbane final for 3rd straight year
items.description: Top-ranked Aryna Sabalenka has advanced to the Brisbane International final for the third year in a row after a 6-3, 6-4 win over Karolina Muchová.

items.title: Bencic leads Switzerland into United Cup final
items.description: Belinda Bencic won her eighth match of the week and combined with Jakub Paul in the deciding mixed doubles to defeat Belgium's Elise Mertens and Zizou Bergs and qualify Switzerland for the United Cup final.

items.title: Dominant Sabalenka reaches Brisbane final
items.description: World number one Aryna Sabalenka reaches the final of the Brisbane International for the third year in a row with victory over Karolina Muchova.

items.title: Poland eliminates U.S., reaches United Cup final
items.description: Poland reached the United Cup final after Katarzyna Kawa and Jan Zielinski beat Coco Gauff and Christian Harrison 7-6 (5), 7-6 (3) in a mixed doubles decider.

items.title: Svitolina, Wang Xinyu advance to Auckland final
items.description: Top-seeded Elina Svitolina will play in the final of the WTA Tour event in Auckland for the second time when she faces Wang Xinyu for the title.

items.title: Players 'not protected' over 'insane' schedule - Sabalenka
items.description: World number one Aryna Sabalenka says tennis authorities "follow their interests" with regards to the tennis calendar and are not "focusing on protecting all of us".
